q: How many boys were colour blind?
Calculate the percentage of colour-blind boys.
Explain why far more boys than girls are colour blind.
The allele is on the X chromosome. Boys (XY) have one X, so one recessive allele shows. Girls need the allele on both X chromosomes.
A colour-blind boy’s parents both see colour normally. Explain how, with genotypes.
He got his X from his mother: she is a carrier Xᴮ Xᵇ. Father Xᴮ Y. The son received Xᵇ and Y.
